annotation.title_clean: Commission Decision (EU) 2015/547 of 1 April 2015 on the safety requirements to be met by European standards for alcohol-powered flueless fireplaces pursuant to Directive 2001/95/EC on general product safety
annotation.title_en: Commission Decision (EU) 2015/547 of 1 April 2015 on the safety requirements to be met by European standards for alcohol-powered flueless fireplaces pursuant to Directive 2001/95/EC on general product safety
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 90/14
annotation.summary_en: Commission Decision under the General Product Safety Directive setting safety requirements that European standards for domestic alcohol-powered flueless fireplaces must meet, covering fire, explosion, surface temperatures, stability, emissions, and warnings. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: European standards for ethanol flueless fireplaces must meet the Annex safety requirements
Maximum thermal output 4.5 kW; surface temperature rise limits by material
Must prevent re-ignition while hot, refuelling while lit, fuel leakage and overturning
Emissions (CO, CO2, NOx, PAHs) must follow WHO guidelines
Mandatory safety warnings, user manual content and manufacturer/importer identification
